name: – Gheorghe Falcă – After § 2 – Am 16
title: REPORT on the deliberations of the Committee on Petitions in 2023
part_text: 2a. Highlights the vital activities carried out by the Committee on Petitions in dealing with petitions, submitted on behalf of 91 organisations that are part of the Fossil Free Politics coalition, calling for the fossil fuel industry to be held to account for its role in the energy and cost of living crises and for an end to fossil fuel influence in EU decision-making; underlines the overwhelming evidence brought to light by petitioners, on the basis of independent academic research, showing that the fossil fuel industry has long been fully aware of the dangers its products pose to the climate and that it has chosen to spread climate denialism and disinformation rather than supporting a transition to a future based on renewable energy;
